title: Gambit page bridge component diagram
description: TypeScript for the page around the Godot web export (godot/web_shell/shell.html), bundled into bridge.js. It starts the engine behind a loading bar and gives the game, as window.chessBridge, what only the page can do; the game reaches it through JavaScriptBridge in godot/scripts/api.gd.

components.name: Page bridge
components.responsibility: Everything bridge.js does in the page.

components.name: Page glue (main.ts)
components.responsibility: Boots the Godot engine from the shell's config with a progress bar and a failure notice; window.chessBridge: baseUrl, returnPath, navigate, takeChallenge (an ?challenge=ID in the address, once), setTitle, copy, bestMove, cancelEngine, preloadEngine.

components.name: Computer opponent (engine.ts)
components.responsibility: Engine: starts Stockfish in a Web Worker on first use, speaks UCI, maps strengths 1–8 to a Skill Level and a depth or move time, pauses the weakest levels so they feel like an opponent, and cancels searches.

components.name: Godot scripts
components.responsibility: The game's Api autoload, which calls window.chessBridge.

components.name: Godot web engine
components.responsibility: The export's index.js loader (global Engine) with index.wasm and index.pck, from Godot's web export template.

components.name: Stockfish 19 (stockfish npm package)
components.responsibility: The lite, single-threaded WebAssembly build, served as engine/stockfish.js and stockfish.wasm; GPL-3.0.

relationships.description: bestMove, cancel and preload behind chessBridge.
JavaScriptBridge.get_interface("chessBridge") and its calls; bestMove answers through a JavaScriptBridge callback.
